channel.title: Vishal Das — Writing
channel.description: Long-form pieces on developer community programs, creator economics, and program management.

item.title: The community metrics that survive a budget review
item.description: Counts are inputs, not results. What to claim when someone is deciding whether your programme continues — and what attribution still can't tell you.

item.title: How to prove what your developer community returned, without engineering help
item.description: The four-table schema and the Apps Script to Looker Studio setup I've built three times, by someone who is not an engineer.

item.title: The streak system that never punishes creators
item.description: Most streak mechanics take something away when you stop. This one pauses instead — four states, nothing lost, and a re-entry path that stays open.

item.title: Why I paid creators for the video, not the views
item.description: Per-view and per-signup payouts both quietly ruin the content. Here's the flat-fee and points structure I used instead, and how to define the content types it depends on.

item.title: How I designed a five-tier ambassador program that 4x'd creator referrals
item.description: Why tier is set by one number, why that number is a rolling average, and how ten creators in four weeks turned into a 4x lift in referrals.
